methods.name: variability factor
methods.description: This parameter scales the standard deviations used to sample the latent space: z′=µ+λvarσz

methods.name: bias factor
methods.description: Instead of using either the posterior or prior distribution, we can sample distributions whose parameters are linearly interpolated between those of the prior and posterior according to a bias factor , referred to as λbias here: z′=µinterp+σinterp z µinterp =λbiasµpost+(1−λbias)µprior σinterp =λbiasσpost+(1−λbias)σprior

methods.name: Conditional variational autoencoder
methods.description: The CVAE input branch encodes the full complex density, while its conditional branch encodes only the receptor density. The complex density is mapped to a probabilistic latent space, which is then sampled as a latent vector z∼N(µ,σ). This is combined with the conditional vector c output by the conditional encoder, and together they are provided to the decoder.

methods.name: atom fitting algorithm
methods.description: an algorithm that combines iterative atom detection with gradient descent to find a set of atoms that best fits a reference density

methods.name: RMSprop
methods.description: optimizer used for training the model

methods.name: U-Net
methods.description: with transposed convolutions and nearest- neighbor upsampling instead of pooling. U-Net skip connections were included between the convolutional features of the conditional encoder and the decoder to enhance the processing of receptor context.

methods.name: Spectral normalization
methods.description: applied to all learnable parameters during training
